policy: Fixed TESS ephemeris, no fit. MJD UTC exposure-start metadata plus half exposure -> geocentric BJD TDB; omitted observatory displacement <=0.022seconds, negligible versus conditional timing envelope. Image metadata documents start time; image-date scale interpreted as UT per public access documentation. Strict flags0/nimaflags0/imgqual<=2; relaxed flags<4/nimaflags<5/imgqual<=2. Both require finite positive PSF uncertainty. Per-object/filter, no pooled colors. Nearest TIC positions not proper-motion propagated; inspect association separations. Timing profile is conditional and not a calibrated confidence interval. Sparse or absent in-event points do not exclude a contaminant.
